claim_boundary: The unemployment rate is a realized household labor-market outcome, not a leading indicator or Bitcoin predictor. A rate no higher than one year earlier may proxy broad labor resilience and risk-bearing capacity, but monetary-policy reactions can reverse the sign. This supports one audit only.

primary_sources.title: Unemployment Rate
primary_sources.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED
primary_sources.use: Official monthly seasonally adjusted unemployment-rate identity and free present-vintage CSV source.

primary_sources.title: Labor Force Statistics from the Current Population Survey definitions
primary_sources.use: Official measurement boundary for unemployed persons, labor force and unemployment rate.

independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_initial_claims: ICSA measured volatile weekly new unemployment-insurance claims and closed before BTC outcomes. UNRATE is a monthly realized household-survey rate; it cannot inherit ICSA support or alter the closed ICSA family.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_activity: UNRATE is neither output, housing authorization, retail demand nor sentiment.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.prohibited_rescue: Do not add payrolls, participation, claims, Sahm thresholds, levels, monthly changes, smoothing, alternate lags, direction inversion or another factor after access.

adversarial_prior: UNRATE is lagging and can remain low until after market prices move.
Strong labor can support demand but also delay monetary easing.
Present-vintage seasonal adjustment and population controls do not reproduce original releases.
The 2020 shock can dominate state variation.
A long-cash rule can reduce drawdown only by forfeiting upside.
stop_conditions: Stop DATA_REJECT before hypothesis or BTC access on any source, lattice or support failure.
If the source gate passes, freeze exactly one hypothesis and economic manifest before BTC outcomes.
Stop NO_CANDIDATE on any economic, drawdown, Calmar, upside, breadth, concentration or determinism failure.
Do not open post-2024 outcomes; a historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED.
